The number of women between the ages of 18-29 who have graduated from vocational high school at least two years ago and who are not looking for a job, exceeds one million. title.narrative: Number of international organizations engaged in overall project activities

description.narrative: A pathway defining the content, schedule, methodology and tools for internationalization of the project will be designed by the project team in consultation with the Ministries, Sabancı Foundation and Project Advisory Committee. International network of UNDP and other relevant UN entities will play a key role in this matter, starting from Türkiye and the nearby regional geography. Relevant international platforms, summits and global networks will be researched to take part, and high-level participation of the project partners in these events will be encouraged.

title.narrative: Number of local action plan guideline for NEET women

description.narrative: A tailor-made training program will be designed and provided to local stakeholders in pilot provinces about how to prepare local action plans for women, particularly NEET women with reference to Women’s Empowerment Strategy Document and Action Plan (2024-2028). The local stakeholders will be promoted to prepare their own action plan based on the guideline for NEET women and share their experiences in the meetings.

title.narrative: Number of consultation meetings held with local stakeholders to develop complementary services for empowerment of NEET women

description.narrative: Empowerment is a broad concept including employability, psychological resilience, self-confidence, well-being, etc. Therefore, capacity building activities for employability of NEET women alone are not sufficient on their empowerment. Based on the white paper, focus group meetings will be organized to raise awareness on the need to develop complementary services that will contribute to empowerment of NEET women in addition to capacity building activities. Best practices will be shared and innovative solutions will be discussed together with local stakeholders. Recommendations will be developed to concretise the guideline for the preparation of local action plans.

title.narrative: Number of analysis report prepared on the employability of NEET women

description.narrative: In addition to business world’s perspective, the research will be conducted to analyse NEET women’ perception, expectation and needs about the employability, particularly about the future skills as an emerging asset in the labour market. Sabancı Foundation will design the content and methodology of this research in consultation with the project team and directly manage it. UNDP will support the design of the research by providing insight with the relevant studies conducted previously. An analysis report will be prepared addressing the employability of NEET women considering the findings of the study and focus group meetings. All relevant expenses for design and implementation of the study will be covered by Sabancı Foundation.

title.narrative: Number of NEET women benefiting from job counselling service

description.narrative: In the second phase of the project, career counselling service is defined as the new activity which is expected to create a broad impact by developing private sector partnerships. Within the scope of this partnership, NEET women’ CVs will be examined, feedback will be given to them in personal and they will be supported in preparing or revising their CV under the supervision of human resource professionals. Additionally, they will be guided to suitable job opportunities. An expert will also be assigned to the project to follow-up career counselling services provided by the company and report the progress of this service regularly.

title.narrative: Average percentage point increase in NEET women trainees’ knowledge as a result of the training programs

description.narrative: Pre-test and post-test will be prepared for training programs. Average percentage point increase şn NEET women trainees' knowledge will be measured.

This activity identify potential stakeholders for collaboration in project activities; Highlight opportunities to create synergies among supporting activities within various programs and projects. The Stakeholder Mapping Report will serve as a foundational document to guide and enhance cooperation efforts, ensuring a cohesive and coordinated approach to addressing the needs of NEET women. The activities and centres carried out by stakeholders for women, particularly for NEET women, will be added to the digital portal to ensure raising awareness and dissemination.

title.narrative: Number of people reached in-directly through news, social media shares, newsletters, blog posts

description.narrative: Throughout the project, the content regarding the project’s current activities will be developed and disseminated in project web site, social media channels and other digital platforms to reach the target group in each month. In addition to news published in different media platforms, UNDP’s newsletter and blog will be used actively. Sabancı Foundation will also design and disseminate content for social media channels and digital platforms to raise an awareness for NEET women in society.

title.narrative: Number of capacity building events for local stakeholders

description.narrative: Following the selection of pilot provinces, a series of online and face-to-face meetings, workshops, and seminars will be organized to facilitate networking, knowledge sharing, collaborative problem-solving and capacity building. These activities aim to discuss and refine potential holistic women empowerment models, training programs, and other capacity development initiatives, while exploring cooperation opportunities among stakeholders. In these activities, White Paper will be introduced to local stakeholders at first. Additionally, these meetings will address collaboration strategies for project dissemination, including introducing the project portal, publishing information on municipal boards, and distributing brochures through relevant institutions. Partnerships with organizations such as İŞKUR and Development Agencies will be established to implement certain services such as trainings, career fairs, job matchmaking, and career counselling and so on. These events, meetings and activities will be crucial not only for fostering effective partnerships and ensuring broad outreach and impact but also building stakeholders’ capacity by creating synergy.

title.narrative: Number of NEET women benefiting from mentorship program

description.narrative: Based on the lessons-learned, guidance and contribution of the stakeholders and project partners about the implementation of the first phase mentorship programmes, mentorship programme will be designed and implemented in a same way. The mentorship program will be open and carried out online for all NEET young women in Türkiye. The programmes will be closely monitored by the project team throughout the implementation process.

title.narrative: Number of NEET women benefiting from training programs

description.narrative: Customized technical, blended, and hybrid learning programs will be developed by building cooperation with local stakeholders. Vocational, future skills and employability training programs will be designed and implemented with key stakeholders. Furthermore, online short sessions and webinars within the scope of future skills and employability skills training programs will be open to all NEET women in Türkiye. These activities aim to eliminate skill mismatches, empower NEET women and lay the foundation for decent work opportunities.
